setting: A student is talking to an IT help desk employee about a problem connecting to the campus Wi-Fi network.
narrator_intro: Listen to a conversation between a student and an IT help desk employee.

dialogue.speaker: speaker1
dialogue.text: Hi, I can't connect my laptop to the campus Wi-Fi anymore. It worked fine last week, but now it just keeps asking for a password even though I'm entering the right one.

dialogue.speaker: speaker2
dialogue.text: That's likely related to the network upgrade we did over the weekend. A lot of students have had similar issues since older saved networks weren't automatically updated.

dialogue.speaker: speaker1
dialogue.text: Oh, that explains it. What do I need to do to fix it?

dialogue.speaker: speaker2
dialogue.text: First, forget the saved network on your laptop completely, then reconnect from scratch using your student login, not your old password. Sometimes people are still typing the previous one out of habit.

dialogue.speaker: speaker1
dialogue.text: That might actually be the problem, I think I've been using my old password without realizing it.

dialogue.speaker: speaker2
dialogue.text: That would definitely cause exactly this issue. If forgetting and reconnecting doesn't work, you may also need to update your network drivers, especially if your laptop is a few years old.

dialogue.speaker: speaker1
dialogue.text: It's about three years old, so that's possible. Is there a way to check if the drivers are outdated?

dialogue.speaker: speaker2
dialogue.text: Yes, I can walk you through checking that right now if the first fix doesn't work. Let's try reconnecting first, though, since that solves it for most people.

narrator_outro: Now get ready to answer the questions.

questions.narrator_text: What problem is the student experiencing?

options.text: Her student login has been deactivated
She cannot connect to the campus Wi-Fi

questions.explanation: She explains her laptop keeps rejecting the password when trying to connect to Wi-Fi.
questions.correctAnswer: She cannot connect to the campus Wi-Fi

questions.narrator_text: According to the IT staff member, what likely caused this issue for many students?

options.text: An error in the student ID system
A virus spreading through the network

questions.explanation: He explains the issue is likely related to a network upgrade done over the weekend.

questions.narrator_text: What mistake does the student realize she might have been making?

options.text: Typing her old password instead of her current one
Using the wrong Wi-Fi network name
Trying to connect from outside the Wi-Fi range

questions.explanation: She realizes she may have been entering her old password out of habit.
questions.correctAnswer: Typing her old password instead of her current one

questions.narrator_text: What does the IT staff member say they will do if the first solution doesn't work?

options.text: Send a technician to her dorm
Help her check whether her network drivers are outdated

questions.explanation: He offers to walk her through checking outdated network drivers if reconnecting doesn't solve the problem.
questions.correctAnswer: Help her check whether her network drivers are outdated
